papers.name: EDA
papers.verified_mechanism: Explicit main/attribute/pronoun/relation/auxiliary component supervision and inference Eq7. EDA uses dense training losses; copying readout alone onto3EED is a transfer hypothesis, not reproduction.

papers.name: SeeGround
papers.verified_mechanism: Target/anchor candidate object lookup, view-aligned rendering and image+spatial description fusion. Original code calls a VLM service and uses object proposals. We reuse candidate/component idea; no learned view selector, no multi-view rendering reproduction.

papers.name: ZSVG3D
papers.verified_mechanism: Separate LOC and executable spatial functions, view-dependent frame construction, LOC variants includeVQA. Our soft score fusion and marginal anchors are own choices, not an official ZSVG3D reproduction.

implementation_boundary: 3EED official and current source readout select class/name-token probability. Keep baseline untouched. New attribute scoring is added as an inference control; no claim that original baseline forgot a required trick.
aggregate_policy: Latest user accepts individual harms if overall metrics improve. Supersedes earlier no-harm gate; retain cases for analysis only.
